methods.raw-central: Always request raw evidence; policy bypass is experiment-only and traced.
methods.fixed-sanitized: Sanitized for public/internal and local-summary for confidential/personal.
methods.network-only: Select the smallest predicted network payload without policy/coverage constraints.
methods.security-only: Select by security level without a coverage constraint.
methods.axnetcc-saea: Hard policy and role-coverage constraints followed by lexicographic optimization.
methods.oracle-feasible: Offline-only: execute all four modes over HTTP and select among observed feasible outcomes.
